2022 / IPIN / Conference paper

An IoT Based Approach for Platform Independent Positioning Service

Anh-Van Vu, Dongsoo Han

2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN) · pp. 1–8

Publisher / DOIRead PDF

Overview

Extends the KAILOS indoor positioning architecture with a dedicated IoT device to decouple sensing and localization from smartphone operating-system restrictions. The hardware and software design supports platform-independent access to indoor positioning services.
